about: The stack machine's mutants: the verifier (vm.Verify) and the loop that runs only verified programs (vm.Exec). Killers are the examples suite (examples:stackvm: its tests and laws, ExecAgreesWithChecked above all, and its cases); each rule names the law or test that kills it.

mutants.name: svm-verify-need-dropped
mutants.rule: ExecAgreesWithChecked: Verify admits an instruction that finds one value fewer than it pops (Joined(0)'s Print at depth 0, or a Bent near miss), and Exec reads a value where Checked traps on Underflow.

mutants.name: svm-verify-depth-off-by-one
mutants.rule: ExecAgreesWithChecked: Tower(65) is admitted, its 65th push lands on stack[0] under the mask, and its sum differs from Checked's. (after > 64 is an equivalent mutant: 64 values fit the [64]int, so the bound 63 keeps one spare slot.)

mutants.name: svm-verify-merge-depth-ignored
mutants.rule: ExecAgreesWithChecked: Joined(0), whose two paths meet at its Print with depths 0 and 1, is admitted, and its jump path prints a value where Checked traps on Underflow.

mutants.name: svm-verify-call-admitted
mutants.rule: CallAndReturn and ExecAgreesWithChecked: a program with a call is admitted and Exec reaches its Unreachable arm, a defect.

mutants.name: svm-exec-mask-narrow
mutants.rule: ExecAgreesWithChecked: Tower(60) pushes past 32 values, the push wraps onto the bottom, and the printed sum differs from Checked's.

mutants.name: svm-exec-resume-drops-printed
mutants.rule: ExecAgreesWithChecked: Printing(k), given exactly the fuel to halt, leaves Exec at its last backward JumpIf and, with this mutant, halts in the checked loop without the values it printed.
